reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet I can carry around solves a problem I don't have. The lab report per batch is a good sign, but it doesn't make me switch from a bottle that costs less per month.
objection: I take it in the evening in my own kitchen, so paying extra for tear-and-go packaging makes no sense to me. I'd also want to see the actual lab report and the full label before trusting any of it.
would_change_my_mind: A real batch report I could read first, showing the magnesium amount matches the label, plus a price close to what a normal bottle of bisglycinate costs per month.
